# 04 — Klyvaron model-by-model qualification results

**Result: 0 operational models verified. Lite, Pro and Max are all BLOCKED for model qualification.** Machine-readable register: [model-register.json](model-register.json), generated by `node scripts/release/generate-model-register.mjs` from the 12 tracked model cards plus an actual filesystem scan.

## Architecture stance (unchanged)

Klyvaron Lite/Pro/Max are **processing/resource/context/orchestration profiles of one shared, model-independent deterministic engine**, not three distinct trained models and not mandatory downloads. The active processor loads no weights, no tokenizer and no external model. Tier→model routes (`/api/klyvaron/{lite,pro,max}`, `/api/klyvaron/models`, `/api/klyvaron/qualification`) are refused with HTTP 410 `model_independent_architecture`. Third-party provider models are labelled as provider models and are **never** represented as first-party Klyvaron.

## Missing artifacts

Each archived card records the expected `.npz` filename, byte count and SHA-256 digest. Examples from [model-register.json](model-register.json):

| Tier | Card | Expected artifact | Expected SHA-256 | Status |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Lite | `aetheris-lite-lm-0.1.1.json` | `aetheris-lite-lm-0.1.1.npz` (see card) | `53ae59b2a777…` | `not_released` |
| Pro | `klyvaron-pro-lm-0.1.0.json` | `klyvaron-pro-lm-0.1.0.npz` (22,761,831 bytes) | `23260d34ab8a…` | `not_released` |
| Pro | same | `klyvaron-pro-lm-fp32-0.1.0.npz` (110,262,030 bytes) | `06b4170baea6…` | `not_released` |
| Max | `klyvaron-max-lm-0.1.0.json` | `klyvaron-max-lm-0.1.0.npz` (see card) | see card | `not_released` |

Archived Pro LM card: 27,559,946 parameters, CPU-only x86_64/AVX-512, ~1,564 MB peak memory, int8-per-tensor quantization, 512-token context. Its own limitations state that two quality ratios exceeded their allowed maxima and GPU qualification remains open. These are **historical experiment metadata**, not release evidence.

## Exact unblock requirement per tier

1. An authorized, licensed weight payload with a trusted download source and a SHA-256 manifest (expected filenames/digests in [model-register.json](model-register.json)).
2. A compatible architecture and hardware: pure-NumPy CPU runtime for these artifacts (Pro fp32 ≈ 110 MB file, ≈ 1.6 GB peak memory); GPU qualification is separate and unverified.
3. An installation procedure that keeps weights **outside Git** (the repository ignores `*.npz`, `*.safetensors`, etc.).
4. Independently verify the downloaded bytes, then record real runtime load, inference, output validity, latency, resource use and error handling for the exact verified bytes.
5. Only then may the tier be classified operational. Metadata, model names, placeholder files, random initialization and successful contract tests are explicitly insufficient.
